---
title: "Visualize macro trends"
output: html_notebook
---

```{r Import libraries}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r Import data}
macro_sections <- read_tsv("tables/macro_trends_genetics_section(1).tsv") %>% select(-`...1`)
macro_keywords <- read_tsv("tables/macro_trends_keywords(1).tsv") %>% select(-`...1`)
macro_sections_top <- read_tsv("tables/macro_trends_top_1000_genetics_section(1).tsv") %>% select(-`...1`)
macro_keywords_top <- read_tsv("tables/macro_trends_top_1000_keywords(1).tsv") %>% select(-`...1`)
```

```{r Cleaned up plotting}

infile <- "top1000" # "corpus" or "top1000"
dev_ <- "svg"
dpi_ <- 300

if (infile=="corpus"){
  df <- macro_keywords
  
  legend_pos <- "right"
  title_ <- "Genetics keywords over time (whole corpus)"
  pct_breaks <- seq(0,0.16,0.02)
  
  w_ <- 8
  h_ <- 6
  fname_ <- "corpus_pages_keywords"
  fname_ <- paste0(fname_, ".", dev_)
} else if (infile=="top1000") {
  # Drop the legend (since they share the legend values)
  # These figures are meant to be side-by-side panels A and B
  df <- macro_keywords_top
  
  legend_pos <- "none"
  title_ <- "Genetics keywords over time (top 1000)"
  pct_breaks_ <- seq(0,0.6,0.05)
  
  w_ <- 6
  h_ <- 6
  fname_ <- "corpus_pages_keywords_top1000"
  fname_ <- paste0(fname_, ".", dev_)
}

# Adjust the year for consistency (these are all Dec 31)
df$year <- df$year+1

# Reshape corpus_pages and corpus_kws into long format for a shared y-axis + legend
df_long <- df %>%
  select(year, corpus_pages, corpus_kws) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(corpus_pages, corpus_kws),
               names_to = "series", values_to = "value")

# Scaling factor to map corpus_kws_pct onto the primary axis range
scale_factor <- max(df$corpus_pages, na.rm = TRUE) / max(df$corpus_kws_pct, na.rm = TRUE)

ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = df_long, aes(x = year, y = value, color = series, linetype = series),
            linewidth = 1) +
  #geom_point(data = df_long, aes(x = year, y = value, color = series)) +
  geom_line(data = df, aes(x = year, y = corpus_kws_pct * scale_factor,
                           color = "corpus_kws_pct", linetype = "corpus_kws_pct"),
            linewidth = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2001, 2026, by = 5)) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Number of corpus pages",
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . / scale_factor, name = "Keyword %", 
                        breaks = pct_breaks_,
                        labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1))
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("corpus_pages" = "#000000", "corpus_kws" = "#000000", "corpus_kws_pct" = "#F2B701"),
    labels = c("corpus_pages" = "Pages (all)", "corpus_kws" = "Pages with keywords", "corpus_kws_pct" = "Keyword %"),
    breaks = c("corpus_pages", "corpus_kws", "corpus_kws_pct") # for legend sorting
  ) +
  scale_linetype_manual(
    values = c("corpus_pages" = "solid", "corpus_kws" = "21", "corpus_kws_pct" = "11"),
    labels = c("corpus_pages" = "Pages (all)", "corpus_kws" = "Pages with keywords", "corpus_kws_pct" = "Keyword %"),
    breaks = c("corpus_pages", "corpus_kws", "corpus_kws_pct") # for legend sorting
  ) +
  labs(x = "Year", color = "Series", linetype = "Series") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.y.right  = element_text(color = "#F2B701"),
    axis.ticks.y.right = element_line(color = "#F2B701"),
    axis.title.y.right = element_text(color = "#F2B701"),
    legend.position = legend_pos,
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    plot.title        = ggplot2::element_text(
        color = "grey10", size = 14, face = "bold",
        margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 15), hjust = 0
      )
  ) + 
  ggtitle(title_)

#       width=w_, height=h_, dpi=dpi_)

```
